tasks.label: Start DUETCS (Docker)
tasks.detail: Builds and runs the site at http://localhost:8080

tasks.label: Stop DUETCS (Docker)
tasks.detail: Stops the containers. Your database is kept.

tasks.label: Reset DUETCS database
tasks.command: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
tasks.detail: Deletes the database volume and starts fresh. Re-run install.php afterwards.
